verdict.rationale: The docs describe a built-in skill creator that interviews the user about what a skill does, when it should trigger, and whether it should include scripts. A recorder drafts reusable skills from demonstrations, and the built-in @plugin-creator skill scaffolds the plugin manifest and a local marketplace entry for packaging. A hands-on probe confirmed plugin-creator installs as a real SKILL.md, and a community user reports building their own skills with skill-creator. Missing for 10: documented guidance for iteratively improving or evaluating existing skills, and in-depth first-party docs on the skill-creator's full workflow.
